mapper.select: SELECT OrderNo AS orderNo, OrderSeq AS orderSeq, ProductCode AS productCode, ProcessCode AS processCode, Price AS price, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, Cost AS cost, CompleteYn AS completeYn, Remark AS remark FROM OrderDetail WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY OrderSeq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OrderMaster ( OrderNo, OrderDate, CustCode, Qty, Discount, Cost, BankingYn, Status, CompleteYn, InsertDate, InsertUserID ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{orderDate}, #{custCode}, #{qty}, #{discount}, #{cost}, #{bankingYn}, #{status}, #{completeYn}, GETDATE(), #{insertUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OrderMaster SET OrderDate = #{orderDate}, CustCode = #{custCode}, Qty = #{qty}, Discount = #{discount}, Cost = #{cost}, BankingYn = #{bankingYn}, Status = #{status}, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId} WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo}
